started_at_basis: Creation time of the (empty) M3 output directory, which the parent created immediately before this task's first tool call. Not the exact instant of that call.
finished_at_basis: Time of the hash/line-count command run after the last artifact (SUMMARY.md) was written and after the JSON parse check and the invisible-character check; delivery.json had not yet been written at that moment.
input_drift_detail: All four pinned repositories verified with `git rev-parse HEAD` at the pinned commits and empty `git status --porcelain`. No INPUT_DRIFT.

toolchain.note: Static source reading only. The only executable checks were: JSON parse of interfaces.json (ConvertFrom-Json), SHA256/line counts (Get-FileHash, System.IO.File.ReadAllLines), and a git HEAD/status check. No Lean/Lake command was executed on any repository, and no new automation script was created.

conventions.line_numbers: 1-based plain-text lines as read from disk, license header included. `lines` in interfaces.json includes the docstring block when the docstring is part of the declaration; `decl_lines` gives the declaration-only lines.
conventions.file_lines_total_source: System.IO.File.ReadAllLines(...).Count (empty lines included). Note that PowerShell `Get-Content | Measure-Object -Line` undercounts because it skips empty lines; it is not the number recorded here.
conventions.signature_form: `raw_signature_verbatim` is a single string with the source line breaks preserved as \n.

repos_head_verified.note: Only `iut` supplied file content to M3. The other three were HEAD-verified because the plan pins them and because T2's card 7 lives in tate-curves-theta; no file from them was read in M3.
